How do you want to log in?

Citiz

requirements.text: Citizens shall log in with their registered 10-digit mobile number and a 6-digit OTP sent by SMS. Department users (Clerk, Officer and Administrator) shall log in with a username and password.
Citizens shall be able to apply for a certificate online.
The Citizen shall be able to view the status of submitted applications in My Applications.
The Applicant Name field is mandatory and shall not exceed 50 characters.
The Mobile Number shall be a 10-digit mobile number starting with 6, 7, 8 or 9.
Only the Clerk shall be able to access the Verification Queue and verify applications.
When the Clerk verifies an application, its status shall change to Verified.
Only the Officer shall be able to access the Approval Queue and approve applications.
When the Officer approves an application, its status shall change to Approved.
Only the Administrator shall be able to access User Management and Reports.
The Citizen shall be able to download the approved certificate as a PDF.
Appropriate error messages shall be displayed for invalid inputs.

requirements.text: The Remarks field length is TBD.
Officers shall log in with their password and a one-time password (OTP) sent by SMS to their registered mobile number.
An OTP shall be valid for 5 minutes and shall be accepted only once.
The Citizen shall receive a confirmation email when an application is submitted.
The home page shall offer a Login button with two options: Citizen Login and Department Login.
The Citizen login shall show an error when the mobile number is not a valid 10-digit number starting with 6, 7, 8 or 9.
The Citizen shall be able to request a new OTP with Resend OTP on the OTP screen.
Logout shall end the session and return the user to the home page.
Applicant Name - Type: Text; Mandatory: Yes; Length: Max 50; Validation: -
Mobile Number - Type: Numeric; Mandatory: Yes; Length: 10; Validation: 10-digit mobile number starting with 6-9
Email Address - Type: Email; Mandatory: No; Length: Max 100; Validation: Valid email format
PIN Code - Type: Numeric; Mandatory: Yes; Length: 6; Validation: 6-digit PIN code
Date of Birth - Type: Date; Mandatory: Yes; Length: -; Validation: Cannot be a future date
Certificate Type - Type: Dropdown; Mandatory: Yes; Length: -; Validation: Values: Income, Caste, Residence
Documents Attached - Type: Multi-select; Mandatory: Yes; Length: -; Validation: Values: Aadhaar, Ration Card, Voter ID, Passport
Purpose of Certificate - Type: Rich text; Mandatory: Yes; Length: Max 300; Validation: -
Address - Type: Text area; Mandatory: Yes; Length: Max 200; Validation: -
Supporting Document - Type: File; Mandatory: No; Length: Max 2 MB; Validation: PDF, JPG or PNG only
Remarks - Type: Text; Mandatory: No; Length: TBD; Validation: -
The system shall respond quickly to user actions.
Pages shall load within 3 seconds.
The session shall expire after 15 minutes of inactivity.
The portal should support multiple languages as applicable.
